name: Duke
text: "Ashcan" Pete deck only. [action] Exhaust Duke: Fight. You attack with a base [combat] skill of 4. This attack deals +1 damage. [action] Exhaust Duke: Investigate. You investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 4. You may move to a connecting location immediately before investigating with this effect.
text_cn: "灰堆"皮特牌組專用。 [action]消耗杜克：攻擊。你該次攻擊[combat]基礎值視為4。這次攻擊造成+1傷害。 [action]消耗杜克：調查。你該次調查[intellect]基礎值視為4。在使用該效果調查前，你可以立刻移動到一個連接地點。
